auditor: independent AI auditor (did not write the paper); a fresh one for every round

audits.summary: All paper numbers trace to registry rows, both re-executed runs (transformer with fresh training, BFS) reproduce exactly, and the code implements the described shared-engine comparison with a fairly tuned heuristic and no leakage. The negative/mixed outcome is stated honestly with thorough limitations and post-hoc labelling; remaining issues are wording (inverted H3 phrasing), a stale compare CSV, and PDF layout defects.

findings.issue: H3 was pre-registered as 'gap worsens with size' but is labelled 'gap shrinks with size'; conclusion says 'deficit does not shrink ... (H3 refuted)', which is logically inverted; 'ceiling effect' for the 41-70 narrowing is mis-attributed (heuristic drops there).
findings.fix: Restate H3 consistently as 'deficit grows monotonically with size', refuted because the gap is non-monotone (0.18, 0.44, 0.32); drop or correct the ceiling-effect remark.

findings.issue: File was overwritten in the last commit and now contains only tune_21_35 rows; test-bin p-values cited as 'from rh compare' exist only in values.tex.
findings.fix: Re-run rh compare for all main tasks so the CSV backs every cited paired p-value.

findings.issue: G3cp rule display overlaps the loss equation; eqs. (1)-(2) overflow the column; author URL overflows the page; Fig. 3 tick labels overlap.
findings.fix: Use a column-width or two-line layout for the rules/equations, break the URL, set explicit x-ticks in the budget figure.

findings.issue: val_3_10 evaluation problems are not excluded from the training sequents, so in-distribution results may include training items.
findings.fix: Pass exclude=training set when generating val_3_10 problems or note it.

findings.issue: Training-size sweep claim has no reported significance test (auditor paired t gives p~0.002, so it holds); 'from few proofs' slightly mischaracterises Aygun et al. (learning without initial proofs via hindsight replay); garbled 'size effect' sentence in results.
findings.fix: Report the paired test for the ntrain sweep, reword the Aygun description, and rewrite the size-effect sentence.
